notes: Circuit follows the Fritzing diagram (led1.png): resistor from column 1 to column 5 (row e), LED legs in columns 5 (long leg/anode) and 6 (short leg/cathode), red jumper from 1a to GPIO17 (physical pin 11), black jumper from 6a to a GND pin (physical pin 20).
Resistor value not stated in the manual; the photo bands look like a typical 330 ohm-range current-limiting resistor, so 330 is an assumption.

Breadboard rows a-e are the 't' bank in the catalogue naming; LED legs are placed in row d of columns 5 and 6, since the diagram shows them in the same column strips as the resistor end and the black wire.
The Pi's GND pins are interchangeable; GND.1 is used for the one the black wire reaches.
The photo of the breadboard, jumper and solder variants are alternative ways to build the LED+resistor series; the breadboard version is modelled.
The optional 3.3V direct-test circuit (led3.png) is not modelled; only the GPIO17 circuit is.
